title: Constant Force Motion in One Dimension
learningObjectives: Calculate acceleration from constant net force and mass in one dimension
Predict velocity and displacement over time under constant acceleration

explanations.text: For constant mass, acceleration equals net force divided by mass.

evidence.quote: The force (F) will be the difference between the opposing forces (thrust minus drag).
However, if the forces become unbalanced, the aircraft will move in the direction of the greater force.

explanations.text: Net force in one dimension is the difference between opposing forces, and unbalanced force produces motion in the direction of the greater force.

evidence.quote: For a constant force and constant mass, the acceleration remains constant.

explanations.text: With constant force and constant mass, acceleration stays constant and velocity increases linearly with time.

behavioralTests.name: zero net force means zero acceleration

predictions.prompt: A 5 kg model aircraft has 10 N net force forward. Predict its acceleration.
A 2 kg model aircraft has 10 N net force backward. Predict its acceleration.
